lastCompletedStory.title: Staleness guard: worker-report fallback only trusts a report whose story matches the expected dispatched story

nextStoryContext: US-004 added expectedStoryId?: string to ReadWorkerOutcomeOptions. When set and report.story does not match, the worker-report fallback is skipped (falls to unknown). When undefined, US-001 behavior is preserved. loop.ts now passes advisoryStoryId as expectedStoryId. 5 new tests in test/supervisor/result.test.ts (36 total, all pass). Full suite: 970 pass / 0 fail.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure TypeScript internal change: added expectedStoryId field to ReadWorkerOutcomeOptions and threaded it from loop.ts. No external npm library introduced or modified.
